doc: The 'children' group of host calls (cleat#3827). Each call is listed here as unbound ('pending: ...') until its binding lands; the PR that binds a call moves its entry from 'unbound' to 'bound' in THIS file and touches no other inventory file. See packages/cleat-ts/groups/README.md.

unbound.cleat_child_workflow_with_options: pending: start a child with a retry policy and other per-child options.
unbound.cleat_await_all_children: pending: waits for every child run id at once.
unbound.cleat_await_any_child: pending: waits for the first of several child run ids.
unbound.cleat_poll_child: pending: a non-blocking read of one child's state.
